description: A collection of essential TypeScript types

latest_release.body:
### Summary

This is a huge release! 120 new types. All open issues resolved. A huge number of performance and correctness fixes.

### Breaking

- Require TypeScript 6  9ec2593
- Require Node.js 22  9ec2593
- Require [`exactOptionalPropertyTypes: true`](https://www.typescriptlang.org/tsconfig#exactOptionalPropertyTypes) in your tsconfig  82f2b44
	- The types no longer have compatibility logic for `exactOptionalPropertyTypes: false`. Disabling it is unsupported.
- Reminder: `type-fest` requires [`strict`](https://www.typescriptlang.org/tsconfig#strict), which is the default since TypeScript 6. Do not set it to `false`.
- Remove the deprecated `IfAny`, `IfNever`, `IfUnknown`, `IfNull`, and `IfEmptyObject` types. Use [`If`](https://github.com/sindresorhus/type-fest/blob/main/source/if.d.ts) with the matching `Is*` type.  6fc1861
- Remove the deprecated `ReadonlyTuple` type. Use `Readonly<TupleOf<Length, Element>>`.  6fc1861
- [`CamelCase`](https://github.com/sindresorhus/type-fest/blob/main/source/camel-case.d.ts), [`PascalCase`](https://github.com/sindresorhus/type-fest/blob/main/source/pascal-case.d.ts), [`KebabCase`](https://github.com/sindresorhus/type-fest/blob/main/source/kebab-case.d.ts), [`SnakeCase`](https://github.com/sindresorhus/type-fest/blob/main/source/snake-case.d.ts), [`ScreamingSnakeCase`](https://github.com/sindresorhus/type-fest/blob/main/source/screaming-snake-case.d.ts), [`DelimiterCase`](https://github.com/sindresorhus/type-fest/blob/main/source/delimiter-case.d.ts), [`Words`](https://github.com/sindresorhus/type-fest/blob/main/source/words.d.ts), and their `*CasedProperties` / `*CasedPropertiesDeep` types: Enable `splitOnPunctuation` by default.  ebc42e5
	- `KebabCase<'div.card::after'>` is now `'div-card-after'` (was `'div.card::after'`).
	- A leading `$` is now removed: `CamelCase<'$foo'>` is `'foo'`.
- `CamelCase` / `PascalCase` (and their `*CasedProperties` types): Disable `splitOnNumbers` by default  976bd26
	- `CamelCase<'p2p_network'>` is now `'p2pNetwork'` (was `'p2PNetwork'`). The other case types already used `false`.
- `CamelCase` / `PascalCase` (and their `*CasedProperties` types): Enable `preserveLeadingUnderscores` by default  8144ba1
	- `CamelCase<'_id'>` is now `'_id'` (was `'id'`). This matches the [`camelcase`](https://github.com/sindresorhus/camelcase) package.
	- `PascalCase<'_foo_bar'>` is now `'_FooBar'` (was `'FooBar'`).
- `Words`: With `splitOnPunctuation: false`, punctuation now stays inside the word: `Words<'hello:world', {splitOnPunctuation: false}>` is `['hello:world']` (was `['hello', ':world']`)  9f2ad66
- [`PartialDeep`](https://github.com/sindresorhus/type-fest/blob/main/source/partial-deep.d.ts): Enable `recurseIntoArrays` by default.  ab0e23d
	- The elements of arrays and tuples are now deeply partial, and the fixed elements of tuples become optional.
	- `allowUndefinedInNonTupleArrays: true` now works alone. Before, it also needed `recurseIntoArrays: true`.
- [`PartialOnUndefinedDeep`](https://github.com/sindresorhus/type-fest/blob/main/source/partial-on-undefined-deep.d.ts): Enable `recurseIntoArrays` by default  939abe3
- [`ExtendsStrict`](https://github.com/sindresorhus/type-fest/blob/main/source/extends-strict.d.ts): Enable `strictAny` by default, so `ExtendsStrict<any, number>` is now `false`. Pass `{strictAny: false}` to get the old behavior.  b2f7ed4
- [`Split`](https://github.com/sindresorhus/type-fest/blob/main/source/split.d.ts): Rename the `strictLiteralChecks` option to `strict`  bc38ddb
- [`StringToArray`](https://github.com/sindresorhus/type-fest/blob/main/source/string-to-array.d.ts): Replace the `mapNonLiteralsDirectly` option with `strict`, which has the opposite meaning. `{mapNonLiteralsDirectly: true}` is now `{strict: false}`.  b61e528
	- The old option names now give a compiler error.
- [`ReadonlyDeep`](https://github.com/sindresorhus/type-fest/blob/main/source/readonly-deep.d.ts): Convert `Date` to the new [`ReadonlyDate
